entries.name: Sacred Precedent
entries.summary: You find the doctrine, sacred-law exception, ritual obligation, or temple precedent that actually governs a difficult case. Use this to force a religious dispute onto authoritative ground, protect someone through recognized custom, or expose a rite that contradicts its own tradition.

entries.name: Sacred Resolve
entries.summary: You anchor yourself to a belief, oath, doctrine, or sacred obligation when pressure urges you to compromise it. Use this to keep purpose and judgment clear through temptation, ridicule, intimidation, or uncertainty.

entries.name: Saddle Guard
entries.summary: You use mount movement as defense, turning shoulder, flank, speed, and height into cover. Can protect a rider, passenger, or nearby ally while repositioning.

entries.name: Saddle-Line Riposte
entries.summary: Use the mount's change of line to evade a close mounted exchange and answer from a new angle before the opponent fully resets. It requires room, balance, and a weapon suited to the duel.

entries.name: Safe Activation
entries.summary: Awaken a minor relic function with preparation, caution, and correct handling instead of brute force. Activates a relic effect while reducing accidental backlash.

entries.name: Safe Fall
entries.summary: You turn a fall, roll, narrow perch, or sudden slip into controlled movement. Prevents a simple loss of balance from becoming injury or helplessness.

entries.name: Safe Hand
entries.summary: Hold, wedge, lift, cut, or bypass the active part of a simple trap without setting it off. Disarms a mundane trap if the mechanism is reachable.

entries.name: Safe Passage Command
entries.summary: Take temporary control of a route crisis, checkpoint, procession, convoy, or civilian movement through recognized authority or emergency necessity. Creates temporary authority over a threatened route, checkpoint, procession, or convoy.

entries.name: Safe Survey Line
entries.summary: Build a working map through an unstable ruin while marking structural hazards, explored branches, and a dependable route back. It reduces the chance of becoming lost without revealing sealed areas you have not actually found.

entries.name: Safe Threshold
entries.summary: Mark a temporary crossing rule using names, geometry, offerings, or anchors. Reduces the risk of passing near a planar boundary or summoned hazard.

entries.name: Safe Unweaving
entries.summary: Find the loose thread in a minor spell, ward, or magical residue and pull carefully. Weakens or suppresses a simple magical effect without detonating it.

entries.name: Safe Word in Bad Company
entries.summary: Establish temporary terms, boundaries, and an exit condition for a negotiation with criminals or illicit operators who still have a reason to bargain. It creates rules for the meeting, not immunity if either side breaks them.

entries.name: Safehouse Web
entries.summary: You reconstruct a likely chain of criminal safe places, cutouts, couriers, and fallback contacts from underworld habits and partial evidence.

entries.name: Saga Knot Unbound
entries.summary: You confront a major curse-thread, prophecy pattern, inherited doom, or story-shaped fate and force it to loosen, reveal itself, or change course. The pattern resists and the change should carry visible cost.

entries.name: Sailor's Balance
entries.summary: You move with a deck, dock, rope bridge, or unstable footing instead of fighting it. Use this to stay balanced, work rigging, move during bad weather, or act safely near waterborne hazards.

entries.name: Salon Gravity
entries.summary: You become the social center of a courtship-heavy gathering, romantic rivalry, or delicate romantic exchange without losing control of the tone. Can protect someone's dignity, redirect romantic competition, or create room for a difficult relationship conversation through poise and reputation.

entries.name: Salon Knife
entries.summary: Damage reputation with a precise polite observation that sounds harmless until the room understands it. Damages reputation through a precise polite observation.

entries.name: Sanctuary Dome
entries.summary: You raise a stable barrier around a small group or position against attacks, weather, hostile magic, and debris from many directions. Repeated heavy pressure can crack it.

entries.name: Scale Courtesy
entries.summary: Use correct posture, naming, gift logic, or restraint when dealing with dragon-linked powers or servants. Prevents a first mistake from becoming an insult.

entries.name: Scale Echo
entries.summary: You manifest a brief draconic bodily quality from your established Type and Nature: scale-hardening, claws or fangs, resistance, altered senses, movement, or another coherent physical trait. The manifestation expresses resonance rather than proving ancestry, bloodline, or inheritance.

entries.name: Scale-Law Invocation
entries.summary: Call on one established draconic manifestation within your resonance—breath, scales, bodily reinforcement, movement, senses, presence, or partial transformation—and intensify it for one scene through your Type and Nature. The invocation remains explicitly draconic and does not grant ancestry, pact rights, independent domain control, or powers derived from Origin, State, or Condition.

entries.name: Scarcity Breaker
entries.summary: You find and combine overlooked sources of water, food, medicine, fuel, fiber, and useful natural material in a harsh environment, turning one desperate survival scene into a workable supply opportunity.

entries.name: Scatter Threat
entries.summary: Fill a short approach with knives, darts, stones, or improvised throws so enemies cannot advance cleanly. Creates a brief danger zone against ordinary movement.

entries.name: Scene Reconstruction
entries.summary: Rebuild the likely sequence of a social event from witness statements, reported timing, who was present, who spoke to whom, and contradictions between accounts. Reveals the most plausible sequence supported by testimony; physical marks, damage, or hidden objects require the relevant investigative skill.

entries.name: Scent Thread
entries.summary: You isolate one strong scent from nearby clutter and follow its immediate direction across a short area.

entries.name: Scent Veil
entries.summary: You wrap a person, object, or trail in controlled smoke that masks scent and blurs a small visual outline. Wind and close inspection can still reveal the passage.

entries.name: Sea Against the Storm
entries.summary: You command sail, rope, deck, crew, cargo, current, and storm as one living battlefield. Use this to save a vessel from disaster, master a sea battle, survive impossible weather, or keep a ship alive against legendary danger.

entries.name: Seal Mark
entries.summary: You place, read, or test a small magical mark of closure, restraint, or containment. Use this to reinforce a lock, notice a seal, hold back a minor force, mark a boundary, or sense whether something has been deliberately bound.

entries.name: Seal Sense
entries.summary: You read the presence, orientation, and rough purpose of magical closures, suppression marks, bindings, and contained power nearby without automatically opening them.

entries.name: Seal of Standing
entries.summary: You manifest supernatural recognition of an actual acknowledged office, oath, title, command, or formal standing you possess. It makes legitimate status harder to dismiss but cannot invent authority you do not have.

entries.name: Sealbind Pattern
entries.summary: You shape a stronger binding pattern across a door, object, spell, wound, spirit, or threshold. Use this to delay escape, contain unstable magic, reinforce a ward, suppress a minor supernatural effect, or prevent a dangerous force from crossing a clear boundary.

entries.name: Seamless Reforge
entries.summary: Reshape an accessible forged metal object through controlled magical stress, correcting bends, joins, balance, fractures, or fit without fully melting it down. The existing mass and material remain limiting, and true craftsmanship still matters for permanent fine work.

entries.name: Seamless Weave
entries.summary: You reweave damaged or separated fiber into a continuous structure with exceptional precision, restoring complex cloth, rope, netting, stitching, or woven construction when enough original material remains. You may also join compatible fibers without ordinary seams or knots, but cannot replace missing mass or fuse unrelated materials.

entries.name: Searing Ray
entries.summary: You focus light into a narrow burning beam against one target or surface. It can cut through fragile material, blind exposed eyes, or deliver concentrated radiant heat.

entries.name: Seating Read
entries.summary: Read seating, titles, pauses, introductions, and service order to understand who truly has power in the room. Reveals the current social structure of a formal scene.

entries.name: Second Angle
entries.summary: Prepare a thrown attack from an unexpected nearby angle and move before the target fully locates the origin. It is useful in cluttered terrain and crowds, but it does not make repeated attacks mysteriously untraceable.

entries.name: Second Face
entries.summary: Build a believable alternate appearance, posture, and manner for a specific social environment. Prevents casual recognition by people who know only one identity.

entries.name: Second Intention
entries.summary: Commit to a believable first attack to draw the expected defense, then redirect into the opening that response creates. It rewards reading a single opponent rather than granting an unavoidable strike.

entries.name: Second Sight
entries.summary: You read the recent history of an object, place, wound, or magical trace through symbolic impressions. Use this to reconstruct what happened, who used magic, or what emotional pressure remains, though the vision is partial rather than perfect.

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.summary: Draw on endurance and battlefield experience to push through exhaustion and recover a small amount of stamina mid-combat.

entries.name: Second-Chance Thread
entries.summary: Catch the instant after a narrow failure and bend probability toward one different plausible continuation: a missed grip catches cloth, a warning arrives a heartbeat sooner, or a fall finds a ledge. It cannot rewrite established events, guarantee victory, or create an impossible outcome.

entries.name: Secure Camp
entries.summary: Establish a safe, defensible camp with appropriate watches and concealment in available terrain. Reduces rest interruption risk and restores more resources during downtime.

entries.name: Seismic Collapse
entries.summary: You force a localized seismic break through stone, floor, tunnel, wall, or battlefield terrain. Use this to collapse cover, break formations, open blocked ground, or make an area impassable, but the effect is loud and difficult to control precisely.

entries.name: Selective Dissolution
entries.summary: Focus corrosion into one chosen layer, seam, lock, joint, coating, or material boundary while sparing nearby matter as much as possible. Use this to open, weaken, etch, or strip a precise target where uncontrolled acid would cause unacceptable collateral damage.

entries.name: Sense Magic
entries.summary: You detect active magical effects, enchantments, wards, illusions, spell residue, or supernatural pressure in the immediate environment. Use this to identify the rough type and direction of nearby magic before touching it.

entries.name: Set Against the Rush
entries.summary: Brace and time a spear against a charge, leap, rush, or closing monster so its own momentum becomes part of the defense. It works only when the approach can be read and physically met.

entries.name: Set and Fire
entries.summary: You brace, range, and release a crossbow shot under pressure with enough discipline to preserve accuracy while using imperfect cover or a hurried firing position.

entries.name: Set the Line
entries.summary: You settle point, seat, and speed into one clean line before impact. Makes a mounted or braced thrust strike with the force of movement rather than arm strength alone.

entries.name: Shadow Hand
entries.summary: You extend a small grasping shape through nearby darkness to move a light object, tug a latch, hide a gesture, or interfere with something just beyond reach.

entries.name: Shadow Shelter
entries.summary: Draw connected darkness around a small group or position, suppressing outlines, stray light, and obvious movement from several directions. It creates a mobile pocket of concealment rather than true invisibility, and strong light or direct contact can expose those inside.

entries.name: Shadow Slip
entries.summary: You bend nearby shadow around your movement for a brief moment. Use this to hide a gesture, cross a dim space, obscure your position, or make a subtle magical escape.

entries.name: Shadow Step
entries.summary: You move through connected shadow or deep darkness to emerge from another nearby shadowed point. Use this for sudden repositioning, escape, infiltration, or striking from impossible angles, but bright light and wards can disrupt it.

entries.name: Shardfield
entries.summary: You command surrounding glass, mirrors, lenses, bottles, windows, and glasslike magical surfaces in a major scene. Use this to reshape a hall of windows, turn shards into a storm, create reflective cover, or expose hidden reflections.

entries.name: Shared Dream
entries.summary: You draw several willing sleepers into one common dream-space where they can communicate, rehearse, explore symbols, or confront a shared nightmare.

entries.name: Shared Guard
entries.summary: You extend a compact barrier to cover one nearby ally along with yourself. It protects a limited angle or brief exchange rather than forming a full defensive field.

entries.name: Shared Instinct
entries.summary: Open a brief magical exchange of senses and instinct with a willing, bonded, or successfully calmed beast. Use this to share warning, scent, direction, prey-focus, or immediate danger without erasing the creature's own will or granting knowledge it does not possess.

entries.name: Shared Recovery
entries.summary: Split one controlled healing working across several nearby injured creatures, stabilizing and restoring each less intensely than a focused treatment. Use this when a group is wounded at once; severe individual injuries still require dedicated care.

entries.name: Shatterline
entries.summary: You send a tuned fracture through connected glass or brittle transparent material, choosing where the break races. It can open a path, disarm glass structures, or turn a prepared surface into a trap.

entries.name: Shield Breaker
entries.summary: Use shield pressure to jam, bind, or batter through an enemy guard instead of only defending. Opens a protected enemy to a follow-up attack or forced movement.

entries.name: Shield Ring
entries.summary: You strike shield, armor, weapon, or hard cover to transmit shock and spoil balance rather than aiming only for flesh.

entries.name: Shield-Splitter
entries.summary: You deliver a hewing strike that treats shield, stance, and lesser armor as obstacles to be split. Can open a powerful foe for allies when the blow lands cleanly.

entries.name: Shielded Interpose
entries.summary: Step into the path of a nearby attack and turn the danger onto your shield guard instead. Redirects one immediate hit away from an ally if your defense holds.

entries.name: Shieldline Pulse
entries.summary: You turn your defense into a brief wall of pressure. Use this with a shield, guard stance, armor, or braced weapon to hold ground, protect someone nearby, or stop an enemy from forcing through.

entries.name: Shift the Premise
entries.summary: Reframe a dispute around a value or consequence the listener already accepts, opening room for reconsideration without compelling agreement. Rank, loyalty, law, and opposing interests still matter.

entries.name: Short-Grip Reversal
entries.summary: You change grips and angles so your polearm answers both close and distant threats. Prevents an enemy from simply stepping inside your reach without consequence.

entries.name: Shortfold
entries.summary: You fold a handspan or few paces of distance for one small transfer, letting an object, hand, or step cross a gap that remains visibly connected.

entries.name: Siege Solution
entries.summary: Apply engineering under pressure to gates, walls, bridges, engines, or barricades. Opens a practical route to breach, defend, reinforce, or disable a large structure.

entries.name: Siegebreaker Grip
entries.summary: You turn raw strength, leverage, and timing into a force that changes the battlefield. Use this to hurl enemies, move massive obstacles, break barriers, stop charging creatures, or make the environment itself part of your attack.

entries.name: Sign Memory
entries.summary: Hold the details of a trail in mind well enough to recover it after weather, crowds, or broken ground. Prevents ordinary confusion from ending the pursuit.

entries.name: Silence
entries.summary: You shape sound into absence or overwhelming pressure. Use this to create a temporary zone of acoustic silence, mute footsteps and speech, interrupt verbal casting, protect against sonic effects, or release a focused deafening burst.

entries.name: Silence Below
entries.summary: You spread a zone of unnatural deep silence and pressure that swallows ordinary sound, weak light, and easy breathing. It controls atmosphere and movement more than it inflicts direct damage.

entries.name: Silent Approach
entries.summary: Control footfall, breath, fabric, and line of sight while closing distance. Lets you approach a distracted or unaware target without triggering ordinary notice.

entries.name: Silent Bypass
entries.summary: Open or defeat a mechanical lock while minimizing the marks, noise, and obvious signs of tampering left behind. It does not make a complex lock easy; it changes the consequences of a successful bypass.

entries.name: Silent Finish
entries.summary: End a close fight without shouting, ringing steel, or a long struggle if the target is already vulnerable. Prevents ordinary noise from giving the moment away.

entries.name: Silent Opening
entries.summary: Take a prepared shot from concealment while minimizing the movement and exposure that would normally reveal the firing position. The environment, noise, witnesses, and the target's attention still decide whether concealment survives.

entries.name: Silent Relock
entries.summary: You open a lock while preserving the appearance that it remains secure. Lets you pass through, inspect, or plant something without making entry immediately obvious.

entries.name: Silver Sight
entries.summary: You read hidden shape and instinct under moonlight or darkness, making tracks, transformations, concealed emotion, or beastlike signs easier to perceive.

entries.name: Silvered Reprimand
entries.summary: Correct a noble, envoy, officer, or petitioner with formal grace that makes crude retaliation cost status. Corrects a target so gracefully that crude retaliation costs status.

entries.name: Silverline Step
entries.summary: You slip along the edge of danger instead of retreating blindly. Use this to dodge, reposition, escape a surrounded position, or move through a threatened space without losing momentum.

entries.name: Singularity
entries.summary: You create a brief point of crushing gravitational pull that drags nearby bodies, debris, missiles, and loose terrain toward it. It is difficult to control, affects friend and foe, and should create serious environmental consequences.

entries.name: Skeletal Lock
entries.summary: You lock a chosen skeletal or fossil structure into stable alignment through Bone Arcana. Use this to brace a willing person's injury, stabilize a limb for safe movement, reinforce a bone-built object, or immobilize skeletal undead and constructs. It cannot seize the joints or control the movement of an unwilling living target, and it does not safely replace medical treatment.

entries.name: Sketch Route
entries.summary: You make a quick usable sketch of a route, room sequence, shoreline, street path, or landmark relationship before memory fades.

entries.name: Skybreak Cyclone
entries.summary: You raise a violent rotating wind across a large area, lifting debris and making stable movement or ranged fire extremely difficult. The cyclone controls space more than it delivers a single precise strike.

entries.name: Skyroad
entries.summary: You move through vertical space like terrain was written for you, turning rooftops, rigging, cliffs, and collapsing structures into a path. Can carry a chase or escape through places others cannot follow.

entries.name: Sleeve Palm
entries.summary: You conceal, reveal, or transfer a small object between hand, sleeve, belt, or nearby surface during ordinary motion when attention is divided.

entries.name: Slip the Beat
entries.summary: Alter your own timing and movement for a heartbeat during a duel, passing a guard or changing measure before the expected counter lands. It enhances one exchange rather than granting unrestricted speed.

entries.name: Smoke Veil
entries.summary: You thicken smoke, soot, ash-laden haze, or suspended particulate into a tactical veil. Use this to hide movement, break line of sight, mask scent, confuse pursuit, interfere with archers, or create a dramatic escape.

entries.name: Smoke Wisp
entries.summary: You shape a thin trail of smoke, soot, ash-laden haze, or suspended particulate into a useful sign, screen, scent mask, or distraction. Use this to hide a small motion, mark airflow, follow a draft, mislead a watcher, or conceal a scent trail briefly.

entries.name: Social Gatekeeping
entries.summary: Open or close access to private rooms, elite gatherings, patrons, witnesses, and social circles through invitation, etiquette, or reputation. Controls access to social circles, patrons, witnesses, or private rooms.

entries.name: Soft Bargain
entries.summary: You make a small deal feel fair, useful, and easy to accept. Use this to negotiate prices, favors, terms, apologies, or practical compromises without turning the scene hostile.

entries.name: Soft Light Ward
entries.summary: You gather brave light around yourself or another person as a thin protective veil. Use this to resist fear, darkness, weak curses, undead pressure, or hostile magical influence.

entries.name: Soft-Step Interposition
entries.summary: Step between conflict parties at the moment violence or insult would become politically, socially, or morally disastrous. Stops a conflict at the point where escalation would become costly.

entries.name: Solar Judgment
entries.summary: You call down focused solar pressure that burns, reveals, and purifies. Use this against undead, curses, shadowed magic, things concealed by supernatural darkness, corrupt growth, or targets vulnerable to solar radiance.

entries.name: Solar Spear
entries.summary: You focus solar heat and radiance into one piercing line against a target, ward, or corrupted point. It is more concentrated than broad Light Arcana illumination.

entries.name: Song That Moves Armies
entries.summary: Shape the emotional truth of a whole gathering through music, poetry, or spoken legend. Can turn a crowd, company, or host toward courage, grief, mercy, or defiance if the moment is ripe.

entries.name: Sonic Lance
entries.summary: You compress vibration into a narrow strike against one body, object, or structural point. It can rupture brittle material, stagger a target, or disrupt concentration through focused resonance.

entries.name: Soul Anchor
entries.summary: You fasten a soul more firmly to body, will, and name for a short crisis. Use this to resist fear, hostile spiritual interference, spiritual destabilization, deathly pulling, or magical severance, or to stabilize a dying person briefly.

entries.name: Soul Sight
entries.summary: You perceive the soul-state of a living being through aura, pressure, warmth, shadow, emotion, and spiritual distortion. Use this to sense corruption, spiritual injury, hostile spiritual influence, soul damage, oath pressure, or significant emotional disturbance.

entries.name: Soul Thread
entries.summary: You create a gentle spiritual link to a willing person, letting you sense whether their soul is present, distressed, displaced, or under hostile pressure.

entries.name: Soul Touch
entries.summary: You make direct spiritual contact with another soul through touch, gaze, oath, or magical focus. Use this to mend spiritual damage, break hostile spiritual interference, expose corruption, steady a fractured self, or harm a hostile spirit at great risk.

entries.name: Soulbridge
entries.summary: You establish a powerful temporary bridge between willing souls for shared strength, memory fragments, or spiritual rescue. The connection does not erase individuality and becomes dangerous if one participant is corrupted or dying.

entries.name: Source Trail
entries.summary: Find the most promising source, archive, witness, or record path instead of searching blindly. Points research toward the best available lead.

entries.name: Sovereign Pressure
entries.summary: Make enemies hesitate, bargain, kneel, reveal fear, or second-guess themselves before violence begins through overwhelming authority and reputation. Makes opponents hesitate, bargain, reveal fear, or yield initiative before violence begins.

entries.name: Spatial Fold
entries.summary: You bend space between two known or visible points, creating a temporary passable fold that takes a moment to stabilize. Long-distance travel, warded locations, and unknown destinations require major setup and may fail dangerously.

entries.name: Spear Fence
entries.summary: You turn the spear into a moving fence, denying approach from several angles and punishing anyone who tries to pass. Holds a narrow lane or protects a vulnerable ally.

entries.name: Spearfield
entries.summary: You command reach so completely that a battlefield around you becomes measured in spear lengths. Can pin, redirect, or deny movement to multiple physical enemies if terrain gives you room.

entries.name: Spearwall Step
entries.summary: You move while keeping the spear point threatening the lane ahead, allowing a controlled retreat, advance, or formation adjustment without surrendering reach.

entries.name: Spell Pattern
entries.summary: Identify the working shape of nearby magic before touching it. Reveals whether a magical effect is active, unstable, hidden, or safe enough to study.

entries.name: Spell-Law Severance
entries.summary: You cut into the governing logic of a powerful spell, ward, ritual, or enchantment. Use this to unravel major magic, expose its core weakness, interrupt a dangerous casting, or create a window for allies to act.

entries.name: Spellcore Overdrive
entries.summary: You draw mana into a roaring crown of power that strengthens and stabilizes your next major magical act. Use this to empower a difficult spell, resist suppression, overpower magical resistance, or hold control during extreme pressure.

entries.name: Spirit Bargain
entries.summary: Negotiate with a ghost, ancestor, local spirit, or sacred presence by offering recognition, duty, or resolution. Creates a peaceful exchange if the spirit has a reason to bargain.

entries.name: Spirit Covenant
entries.summary: You form a serious temporary pact with a spirit, ancestor, shrine presence, or haunting force. Use this to gain guidance, protection, passage, testimony, or supernatural aid for one major scene, with respect or payment expected in return.

entries.name: Spirit Lantern
entries.summary: You create a gentle beacon visible or sensible to nearby spirits. It can invite peaceful contact, reveal a haunting path, or guide an unsettled presence without compelling it.

entries.name: Spirit Separation
entries.summary: You force a temporary gap between a hostile spiritual influence and the soul it is clinging to. This can create an opening against invasive spiritual magic without automatically harming the host.

entries.name: Spirit Ward
entries.summary: You draw a temporary boundary that spirits, ghosts, or unseen local powers hesitate to cross. Use this to protect a room, calm a haunting, shield a person from spiritual pressure, or force a weak spirit to reveal itself.

entries.name: Spirit Whisper
entries.summary: You reach toward a nearby spirit, haunting, shrine presence, ancestral echo, or animistic force with a careful word, gesture, or offering. Use this to sense a spirit mood, ask a simple question, calm a minor haunting, or notice unseen presences.

entries.name: Spreading Rot
entries.summary: You set a controlled magical blight moving through connected organic material, such as roots, vines, fungus, stored grain, dead vegetation, or wooden growth. The blight needs a connected medium and must be contained.

entries.name: Spur Through
entries.summary: Drive a mount through a contested gap before enemies close it. Breaks past ordinary bodies or loose formation if the mount can physically pass.

entries.name: Stabilize the Impossible
entries.summary: Keep a critically injured or rapidly worsening patient alive long enough for further treatment when ordinary first aid would likely fail. It buys a treatment window rather than erasing the underlying injury.

entries.name: Stabilizing Additive
entries.summary: Adjust a potion, brew, poison, or volatile mixture before it spoils or reacts badly. Reduces mishap and improves the intended effect of a prepared substance.

entries.name: Stage Spark
entries.summary: You turn voice, movement, timing, or presence into a moment people want to watch. Use this to perform, distract, command attention, or make a simple scene feel larger than it is.

entries.name: Stand Fast
entries.summary: You hold your ground and keep following a chosen course while pressure builds. Use this to resist sustained intimidation, battlefield fear, panic, or social pressure long enough to complete what you committed to do.

entries.name: Star Sight
entries.summary: You draw cold starlight into your senses, revealing hidden markings, magical concealment, distant alignment, night paths, celestial omens, or faint traces that ordinary light misses.

entries.name: Starfall Barrage
entries.summary: You turn ranged pressure into a sky of falling threat that controls the entire battlefield lane. Use this to pin formations, cover allies, punish clustered enemies, or make movement through an area nearly impossible.

entries.name: Starlight Compass
entries.summary: You orient yourself by celestial pattern even through partial cloud, unfamiliar terrain, or magical confusion, provided the sky or a known star resonance can still be reached.

entries.name: Starpath Alignment
entries.summary: Fix a line between your position and a distant visible, known, or celestially referenced destination through starlight and constellation geometry. Use it to guide impossible navigation, align a long-range strike, or establish cosmic direction without teleporting across the distance.

entries.name: Static Veil
entries.summary: You maintain a charged field close to your body or gear that shocks contact, warns of nearby conductors, and can spoil a weak incoming metal strike or grab.

entries.name: Steady Beast
entries.summary: Calm a frightened mount, companion animal, or nearby beast long enough to prevent panic, bolting, or uncontrolled aggression. Suppresses ordinary animal panic for the moment.

entries.name: Steady Heart
entries.summary: You steady your breathing and refuse the first instinct to freeze, flinch, or flee. Use this to act clearly through immediate fear, intimidation, shock, or sudden danger without making yourself immune to it.

entries.name: Steady Helm
entries.summary: You stabilize a vessel, craft, machine, or flying device before a small error becomes disaster. Keeps basic control during takeoff, docking, landing, or sudden turbulence.

entries.name: Steady Seat
entries.summary: Stay mounted through fear, impact, bad ground, or sudden movement. Prevents an ordinary fall and keeps the mount under control.

entries.name: Steady Vow
entries.summary: Anchor yourself in oath, prayer, doctrine, or chosen duty when fear or temptation rises. Resists ordinary intimidation and despair for the moment.

entries.name: Steadying Command
entries.summary: You give a clear danger command through voice, posture, reins, or scent cues that a trained or trusting animal can follow under stress. Prevents panic and enables a coordinated protective action.

entries.name: Steel Halo
entries.summary: Set several nearby metal objects into controlled orbit around yourself or a chosen point, using polarity to intercept loose threats, threaten approaches, or launch individual pieces. The halo depends on available metal and can be disrupted by stronger forces or competing control.

entries.name: Stillfield
entries.summary: You damp movement across a defined area, making acceleration, charges, falling debris, and fast projectiles lose momentum. Slow deliberate motion remains possible.

entries.name: Stillness Field
entries.summary: You spread a quiet deathly pressure through an area that suppresses corpse animation, weakens uncontrolled undead motion, and makes living exertion feel heavy. It is broad control rather than direct killing power.

entries.name: Stillwinter Seal
entries.summary: Freeze one target, mechanism, doorway, limb, surface, or moving part into a rigid state of extreme cold for a brief critical window. The seal can arrest motion or preserve something, but sufficient heat, force, or magical resistance can break it.

entries.name: Stone Bastion
entries.summary: You raise thick stone cover around yourself or several nearby allies, shaping firing gaps and protected angles. Its broad defensive coverage trades raw Power for reliable shelter.

entries.name: Stone Fragment
entries.summary: You drive stone, soil, grit, or compacted earth outward with enough force to strike, distract, stabilize, or shape a small surface. Use this to attack, create footing, reveal buried material, or break fragile terrain.

entries.name: Stone Lance
entries.summary: You shape nearby stone or compacted earth into a narrow projectile and drive it at one target. This is a focused attack with greater penetration than the basic Stone Fragment.

entries.name: Stoneflow Passage
entries.summary: Make earth or workable stone flow aside and settle again in a controlled route, opening a passage, trench, stair, crawlspace, or escape without the uncontrolled breakage of brute force. Dense reinforcement, worked wards, and insufficient material still constrain the result.

entries.name: Stonehail Zone
entries.summary: You rain stones into a chosen patch of ground until enemies cannot cross it safely. Creates a denial zone against clustered or advancing foes.

entries.name: Storm Cage
entries.summary: You establish a charged zone where arcs jump between nearby conductors and moving targets. It can restrict movement and punish clustered enemies but is dangerous around allies, water, and metal.

entries.name: Storm Call
entries.summary: You pull on existing wind, cloud, pressure, rain, or charged air and intensify it toward storm conditions. Use this to strengthen bad weather, summon lightning risk from a charged sky, drive rain harder, or make travel and ranged combat more difficult.

entries.name: Storm Command
entries.summary: You impose order on sail, rope, current, cargo, crew, and weather during a crisis at sea. Use this to keep a vessel functional through storms, battle, reefs, boarding action, or shipboard disaster.

entries.name: Storm Oars
entries.summary: You force a craft through storm surge, rapids, ice floes, or hostile pursuit by reading every pull of water. Can turn a deadly water crossing into a survivable route.

entries.name: Storm Sense
entries.summary: You read storm pressure, shifting wind, charged air, cloud movement, and dangerous sky signs before the weather breaks. Use this to predict storms, sense aerial danger, notice wind-borne magic, or prepare before lightning, rain, or violent air movement arrives.

entries.name: Storm of Hands
entries.summary: Chain movement and thrown weapons into a rapid pattern that divides enemy attention across the whole exchange. Pressures multiple nearby targets if you have ammunition and space to move.

entries.name: Stormbreak Corridor
entries.summary: Force a temporary corridor of reduced wind, rain, lightning exposure, or violent pressure through an existing storm so a small group, vessel, or critical action can pass. It parts danger rather than ending or fully controlling the storm.

entries.name: Stormmaster Seamanship
entries.summary: You command sail, rope, deck, cargo, crew, current, and storm as one living system. Use this to keep a vessel alive through battle, reefs, boarding, storms, sea monsters, or shipboard disaster.

entries.name: Stormrunner Seamanship
entries.summary: You read ship, rope, sail, cargo, current, and weather as one moving system. Use this to keep a vessel functional during danger, prevent a shipboard disaster, or act decisively in storms and rough water.

entries.name: Stormswimmer
entries.summary: You master storm surf, deep current, cold shock, and drowning panic long enough to turn water into your battlefield. Can fight, rescue, or escape in conditions that would kill ordinary swimmers.

entries.name: Story Thread
entries.summary: You notice when a person, promise, object, or place has become entangled in a repeating narrative pattern. The thread suggests pressure and connection rather than dictating what must happen.

entries.name: Street Read
entries.summary: Navigate commoner districts, criminal environments, and unofficial social hierarchies without standing out. Passive; prevents exploitation and enables natural movement in low-status contexts.

entries.name: Stressline Temper
entries.summary: You restore, reinforce, or reshape metalwork with expert judgment and force. Use this to repair serious damage, strengthen armor, prepare a weapon for a major fight, or make metal gear survive impossible stress.

entries.name: Structural Appraisal
entries.summary: Identify weak masonry, hidden repairs, quarry origin, load-bearing risk, sabotage signs, or dangerous construction faults. Reveals weak points, hidden repairs, sabotage signs, or failure risks.

entries.name: Structural Shot
entries.summary: Aim a crossbow bolt at a rope, latch, brace, winch, hinge, trigger, or other understood mechanical weak point instead of a person. A successful shot can disable or alter a device that can realistically be affected by the projectile.

entries.name: Structure Breaker
entries.summary: You deliver a crushing blow meant to break structure: door, shield, bone guard, siege brace, monster shell, or formation anchor. Can disable a hard defense when force is the right answer.

entries.name: Stubborn Duty
entries.summary: Resist intimidation, bribery, fatigue, or social pressure when a duty, dependent group, structure, or responsibility is at risk. Improves resistance to fatigue, bribery, intimidation, and pressure tied to duty.

entries.name: Subtle Nudge
entries.summary: Influence a scene through timing, questions, songs, misplaced objects, selective silence, or indirect framing without forcing decisions. Shifts a scene through indirect influence without overriding agency.

entries.name: Succession Knot
entries.summary: You untangle a difficult inheritance or succession question by mapping marriages, recognized children, wards, claims, exclusions, and the rules governing their priority. Use this to expose the strongest legal weakness or hidden consequence in one contested claim.

entries.name: Sunk-Cost Trap
entries.summary: You control the emotional rhythm of a gambling table, making fear, greed, pride, and sunk cost work for you. Can turn a game into leverage over information, debt, or access.

entries.name: Sunless Inferno
entries.summary: You flood a large zone with dense supernatural flame that clings to terrain and consumes available fuel. It is devastating area control, but escape routes, fire resistance, weather, and collateral consequences remain important.

entries.name: Sunspark
entries.summary: You kindle a spark of solar heat, daylight, courage, or cleansing force. Use this to brighten darkness, burn minor corruption, steady fear, reveal a hidden stain, harm a light-sensitive creature, or warm unnatural cold.

entries.name: Suppression Lock
entries.summary: You place a temporary seal on one magical function, doorway, object, summoned presence, or active effect. The seal suppresses rather than destroys and can be broken by sufficient force or correct counterwork.

entries.name: Surface Memory
entries.summary: You read texture, temperature, residue, wear, and tiny irregularities through careful touch, useful when sight is poor or a surface has been handled.

entries.name: Surrender Terms
entries.summary: You offer surrender, retreat, or obedience in a way that makes refusal feel like chosen destruction. Can break morale in ordinary troops, criminals, or frightened crowds.

entries.name: Sweeping Circle
entries.summary: You sweep a controlled circle that punishes anyone entering your reach. Creates a temporary zone where enemies risk being tripped, checked, or driven back.

entries.name: Sweeping Intercept
entries.summary: Use shield position to survive the first pressure while the polearm redirects an enemy crossing your guarded arc. It can push an attacker off a chosen line without pretending one fighter controls every direction at once.

entries.name: Sweeping Threat
entries.summary: You turn a large blade into a moving threat that controls space around you. Enemies entering the arc risk being checked, cut, or driven away before closing.

entries.name: Table Tell
entries.summary: You read one small tell in a game, wager, or risk exchange: hesitation, greed, bluff, fear, or desperation. Reveals whether the next move is cautious, reckless, or bait.

entries.name: Taboo Pattern Reading
entries.summary: You unravel the layered logic of dangerous occult work and identify which component feeds, anchors, masks, or propagates the effect. Use this to locate a credible interruption point without assuming that touching it is safe.

entries.name: Tactical Reposition
entries.summary: Read the battlefield and direct allies into better cover, spacing, or pressure before the enemy exploits disorder. Repositions a willing group into a stronger tactical state.

entries.name: Take the Stage
entries.summary: You seize the attention of a room and turn it into momentum. Use this to perform, distract, rally, shame, impress, or make a public moment impossible to ignore.

entries.name: Targeted Taunt
entries.summary: Bait a target into a specific emotional response: anger, overconfidence, or defensive reaction. Useful for creating openings, forcing errors, or redirecting attention.

entries.name: Temper the Flaw
entries.summary: Identify and correct a dangerous weakness in a metal object during repair or forging, preserving the piece instead of simply replacing it. It requires suitable heat, tools, and material to work with.

entries.name: Tempest Throne
entries.summary: You command a major existing storm as a battlefield-scale system of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning for one decisive scene. The storm remains dangerous to everyone and cannot be made perfectly selective.

entries.name: Tension Feel
entries.summary: You feel load and strain through rope, wood, metal, cloth, mechanisms, or a held object and notice when something is close to slipping, snapping, or releasing.

entries.name: Terms Both Sides Can Sell
entries.summary: Frame an agreement so each side can explain it to their own allies as a defensible success, reducing the political cost of compromise. It cannot make fundamentally unacceptable terms acceptable.

entries.name: Terms of Surrender
entries.summary: You design an end-state for a negotiation in which continued refusal costs more than conceding while the losing side retains enough face, safety, or certainty to accept. Use this for exceptionally high-stakes settlements, capitulations, or crisis bargains; it cannot compel acceptance.

entries.name: Terrain Ambush
entries.summary: Use ground, wind, cover, and approach signs to turn a known route into a prepared interception. Creates a strong opening advantage when the target enters the prepared ground.

entries.name: Terrain Overlay
entries.summary: You combine a map with visible terrain, elevation, roads, water, and landmarks to correct orientation and spot where the map is outdated or simplified.

entries.name: Territorial Roar
entries.summary: You project draconic presence and territorial warning across a broad area, making lesser creatures hesitate and marking the scene with an obvious supernatural challenge. Strong will and rival authority can resist, and the manifestation does not establish legal ownership, draconic rank, or actual territorial rights.

entries.name: Testament of the Soul
entries.summary: You carry your faith through an ordeal capable of shattering ordinary conviction. Use this when confronting legendary corruption, divine-scale pressure, or impossible spiritual doubt; it preserves choice and purpose rather than guaranteeing truth or protection.

entries.name: The Missing Piece
entries.summary: Commit to a complete social explanation that accounts for testimony, motive, relationships, access claims, and the strongest unresolved contradiction. If the available accounts genuinely support it, this identifies the person, claim, or question most likely to break the case open; it does not manufacture evidence or force hidden truth to be revealed.

entries.name: Thorn Lance
entries.summary: You drive one hardened branch, root, or magically grown thorn into a focused piercing attack. It can punch through soft cover or pin material to the ground.

entries.name: Thousand Reflections
entries.summary: You command every viable reflection in a large scene to carry images, warnings, false movements, or linked sight at once. Broken, covered, or warded surfaces remain unavailable.

entries.name: Thousand-Point Constellation
entries.summary: Your thrown weapons or improvised projectiles move like planned stars across the scene. Use this to interrupt multiple enemies, strike from impossible angles, disarm, distract, or pressure an entire close-range group.

entries.name: Thread Choir
entries.summary: You control several separate masses of fiber at once, coordinating ropes, nets, sails, curtains, banners, clothing, rigging, or loose textiles as parts of one deliberate action. Every effect still requires suitable existing material and remains limited by its strength, position, and scale.

entries.name: Thread the Needle
entries.summary: Take one demanding shot through a narrow, shifting, or partially obstructed opening that ordinary archery would treat as impractical. It creates a credible precision line rather than ignoring cover or distance.

entries.name: Threat Measure
entries.summary: You take the exact distance where your weapon threatens and theirs does not. Lets you deny one careless advance, retreat, or draw attempt if the duel remains focused on you.

entries.name: Threat Vault
entries.summary: You vault through a threatened gap, over an obstacle, or past a larger foe before they can close the line. Converts difficult terrain into a repositioning advantage.

entries.name: Three-Point Bind
entries.summary: Use staff, ground, and body position to trap a limb, weapon, shield, or beast muzzle long enough to control the immediate exchange. It relies on leverage and positioning rather than raw strength.

entries.name: Three-Point Traverse
entries.summary: You keep three secure contacts while moving across an exposed wall, ledge, rigging line, broken structure, or awkward overhang. Use this to cross a difficult section steadily or guide another climber through it without turning the move into an impossible ascent.

entries.name: Threefold Vanish
entries.summary: You remove yourself from a scene in stages: sound first, silhouette second, trail last. Can escape an organized search unless the hunters have magic, sealed exits, or direct contact.

entries.name: Throne Recognition
entries.summary: You force a major scene to confront the supernatural weight of a genuinely established claim, office, inheritance, or public recognition. It can compel attention and formal response, but cannot create legitimacy where none exists.

entries.name: Thronebound Decree
entries.summary: You speak with supernatural authority backed by legitimacy, bloodline, oath, office, or recognized command. It cannot force obedience from those with no reason to recognize the authority, but it makes refusal consequential.

entries.name: Through-Armor Shock
entries.summary: You strike armor, shield, wall, limb, or floor so impact travels through protection instead of glancing off it. Can stagger or disrupt a defended target without needing a clean wound.

entries.name: Thrown Star Flick
entries.summary: You snap a small weapon or object toward a weak point, distraction point, or exposed target. Use this for thrown knives, stones, axes, tools, or improvised projectiles.

entries.name: Thunder Charge
entries.summary: Commit mount and rider to a powerful charge that breaks hesitation and scatters weak footing. Forces ordinary enemies to brace, dodge, or be driven aside.

entries.name: Thunderfall Blow
entries.summary: You wield impact like thunder, making ground, armor, and bodies answer the strike. Can scatter a clustered melee or break a major physical obstacle through overwhelming concussive force.

entries.name: Thunderhead Prison
entries.summary: You concentrate violent wind, rain, and electrical pressure around a chosen area, making movement and visibility difficult while threatening conductive targets.

entries.name: Thunderstep
entries.summary: You discharge lightning through a short movement, crossing a visible gap with explosive speed and leaving a stunning crack behind. The path is direct and obvious rather than true teleportation.

entries.name: Thunderstrike
entries.summary: You call a massive lightning strike onto a visible or marked point, followed by concussive thunder. Use this to break a fortified position, scatter a formation, damage a major foe, or announce supernatural force across the battlefield.

entries.name: Tidal Bastion
entries.summary: You raise a rotating mass of water around a position as an omnidirectional barrier and counterflow. It can catch projectiles, blunt charges, and throw attackers aside, but requires substantial water or magical effort to sustain.

entries.name: Tide of Instinct
entries.summary: You awaken controlled instinct across a group, sharpening reaction, scent, balance, and emotional honesty while making restraint harder. Participants retain choice and identity.

entries.name: Tight Turn
entries.summary: You angle a cart, wagon, coach, sled, or chariot through tight space without losing cargo or passengers. Enables controlled movement through crowds, mud, alleys, or rough ground.

entries.name: Timely Arrival
entries.summary: Arrive or re-enter a scene plausibly at a significant turning point when prior travel, rumor, invitation, or setup supports it. Allows plausible arrival at a turning point when travel, rumor, or setup supports it.

entries.name: Titan Brace
entries.summary: You reinforce your body against one immense load, impact, or attempt to move you. It magnifies a real stance or hold rather than making you immovable by definition.

entries.name: Titan Break
entries.summary: Put your full strength into smashing a major barrier, pinning a larger foe, or breaking a defensive stance that ordinary force could not move. Overcomes major physical resistance when brute force is plausible.

entries.name: Titan Grip
entries.summary: You fill your body or hands with mythic weight and leverage. Use this to lift, drag, brace, shove, hold, carry, or break something beyond normal strength for one focused action.

entries.name: Titanfall Breaker
entries.summary: You bring colossal force into one decisive act. Use this to break a gate, shatter a siege engine, stop a monster charge, move a massive obstacle, crack a battlefield position, or make the ground answer your impact.

entries.name: Total Body Lock
entries.summary: Control an enemy body so completely that weapons, footing, and escape routes all become liabilities. Can neutralize a single mundane opponent at close range if size and supernatural force do not make it impossible.

entries.name: Tower's Survey
entries.summary: You awaken the Tower within the Luporian medallion while deliberately examining one nearby room, doorway, passage, camp edge, or other clearly bounded area. For this immediate watch, the medallion reveals active crossings, concealed movement, recently disturbed access points, or physical intrusion within that boundary even when ordinary sight or hearing would struggle to catch it. It reveals that something is moving through or has disturbed the watched area, not identity, intent, or unrelated hidden information.

entries.name: Toxic Bloom
entries.summary: You release or transform poison into a dangerous localized hazard, such as a venom cloud, toxic slick, numbing contact poison, or purging antidotal burst. The effect must remain limited, visible, and containable.

entries.name: Toxin Hint
entries.summary: You notice that a sample contains an unusual bitter, metallic, numbing, burning, or otherwise suspicious component before consuming enough for a full dose when possible.

entries.name: Toxin Sense
entries.summary: You magically distinguish common venom, poison, irritant, and antidotal traces in a nearby sample, wound, drink, or surface. It gives a useful warning rather than a complete laboratory analysis.

entries.name: Trace Sight
entries.summary: You focus on one recent magical, physical, or emotional trace and make its direction or connection clearer. It can follow residue through clutter but cannot invent information that left no trace.

entries.name: Trade Appraisal
entries.summary: Judge the value, origin, authenticity, and political risk of goods, tribute, rare materials, tolls, or gifts after inspection. Reveals value, origin, authenticity, and trade risk beyond ordinary price guessing.

entries.name: Trade Wind Turn
entries.summary: You sense the point where scarcity, fear, opportunity, and leverage meet in a deal. Use this to shift trade terms, identify profitable movement, expose price manipulation, or turn a bad bargain into a useful one.

entries.name: Trade the Pressure
entries.summary: Convert a faction demand into an exchange of concrete concessions, timing, access, guarantees, or face-saving terms that both sides can evaluate. It creates a negotiable structure without erasing the underlying conflict.

entries.name: Traditional Courtesy
entries.summary: Invoke old obligations, hospitality precedents, local custom, or family courtesies to bind a negotiation politely. Binds negotiation through custom, hospitality, precedent, or old obligation.

entries.name: Trail Glint
entries.summary: A useful sign catches your eye: bent grass, disturbed mud, broken bark, old ash, or a track others missed. Use this to follow a trail, notice recent passage, or avoid getting turned around outdoors.

entries.name: Trail by Scent
entries.summary: You follow a distinctive person, animal, substance, or object by scent through mixed terrain when the trail is recent enough to persist.

entries.name: Transmuting Batch
entries.summary: Prepare a difficult mixture that changes the behavior of metal, stone, flesh, plant, or magic-touched residue for one scene. Produces a strong material effect without becoming permanent creation.

entries.name: Trap Reversal
entries.summary: You convert a dangerous trap into a controlled advantage instead of merely disarming it. Use this to redirect a trap, preserve it for enemies, create a warning system, or safely extract its mechanism for later use.

entries.name: Trap Reversal Mark
entries.summary: You do more than disable a trap; you turn its mechanism into warning, cover, delay, or a threat against pursuers. Use this to repurpose a simple or moderate trap without needing perfect workshop conditions.

entries.name: Trap Turnabout
entries.summary: You seize control of a trap's purpose and make it serve your side. Use this to reverse, preserve, redirect, disable, or weaponize a complex trap without destroying its useful mechanism.

entries.name: Trap-Step Attack
entries.summary: Fight around a known trap, trigger, pit, snare, or mechanical hazard so the threat constrains an opponent while you stay inside the safer route you identified. The hazard must actually exist and be understood.

entries.name: Trauma Focus
entries.summary: You impose disciplined triage on a severe medical scene, separating what must be treated now from what can wait. Use this to stabilize dangerous wounds, manage shock or poison symptoms, and keep several immediate problems from becoming fatal at once.

entries.name: Triage Authority
entries.summary: Impose order during injury, panic, plague fear, crowding, or disaster by assigning care, space, priority, and immediate duties. Creates order in injury, panic, crowding, or disaster through care priorities.

entries.name: Trial by Conviction
entries.summary: Hold to a moral accusation or defense under public pressure, using conviction, doctrine, consistency, and openly stated principles to keep the issue from being dismissed. Strengthens a confrontation where faith and moral credibility matter, but does not reveal lies or corruption supernaturally.

entries.name: Trial of Faith
entries.summary: You hold a coherent spiritual purpose through curses, false signs, ritual pressure, or crises of belief. Use this to continue a rite, confront a profane influence, or act deliberately when faith itself is being tested.

entries.name: Trickstone Cast
entries.summary: You cast a stone at an angle meant to distract, ring metal, break glass, or strike an exposed point rather than simply hurt. Creates a small tactical opening at range.

entries.name: Trigger Glint
entries.summary: You notice the tiny wrongness of a wire, tile, latch, groove, pressure plate, or hidden mechanism. Use this to spot, avoid, or cautiously test simple traps.

entries.name: Trigger Rune
entries.summary: You inscribe a rune that releases one simple prepared effect when a clear physical condition is met. The trigger must be concrete enough for the mark to recognize.

entries.name: Trigger Sense
entries.summary: Notice the pressure, line, catch, scent, rune, or disturbed surface that gives a trap away. Prevents accidental triggering when careful movement is possible.

entries.name: Triggered Ward
entries.summary: You place a ward on an object, threshold, or small area that activates when one clearly defined physical or magical condition is met. It may lock, seal, illuminate, sound an alarm, reinforce a barrier, or produce another simple prepared response within Enchantment Arcana's normal domain.

entries.name: True Edge
entries.summary: You straighten, grind, and temper a damaged blade, tool edge, point, or small metal working surface back into reliable condition. It requires suitable tools, heat, and material, and restores practical function rather than creating a masterwork from scrap.

entries.name: True Self Anchor
entries.summary: Strengthen the continuity and spiritual integrity of one willing soul against hostile supernatural alteration or displacement. It reinforces the person's connection to self, body, and will without making the body or mind invulnerable.

entries.name: Trust Signal
entries.summary: Use posture, tone, scent discipline, and patience to show a wary animal that you are not immediate prey or threat. Opens a path to cooperation if the animal has reason to listen.

entries.name: Truth-Laced Lie
entries.summary: You build a lie around enough truth that it becomes hard to pull apart. Use this to maintain a false identity, misdirect an investigation, protect a secret, or survive serious questioning.

entries.name: Turn the Mechanism
entries.summary: After understanding a trap or mechanical hazard, alter its trigger or direction so it threatens a different route or becomes a controlled obstacle. It requires access to the actual mechanism and enough time to work.

entries.name: Turn-Saddle Shot
entries.summary: Fire while the mount changes direction, withdraws, or passes the target, preserving mounted movement instead of stopping for a perfect stance. The shot still needs a real line and a mount you can control.

entries.name: Turning Bulwark
entries.summary: You turn the staff into a rotating wall of reach, redirection, and pressure. Protects nearby allies while denying ordinary movement through your guarded space.

entries.name: Twilight Seraph Vessel
entries.summary: Your body becomes the vessel of a dusk-seraphic presence formed from mingled radiance and shadow, intensifying Twilight Arcana through shifting wings, veils, contrast, and dusk-born counterpressure. Use this to move through mixed light and shadow, protect through obscuring contrast, reveal through twilight, or contest magical extremes of radiance and darkness; it does not grant general healing, purification, celestial authority, or anti-undead power.

entries.name: Twilight Veil
entries.summary: You blend radiance and shadow around one attack or movement, using shifting contrast to slip past defenses that rely on glare, darkness, shadow concealment, or light-based visibility. It does not ignore unrelated armor, resistance, immunity, or wards.

entries.name: Twin Cast
entries.summary: You throw two light projectiles in one coordinated motion at the same target or two nearby threats. Coverage increases while each throw carries slightly less precision than a single focused cast.

entries.name: Twin Manifestation
entries.summary: You sustain two modest summoned servants, constructs, or force-shapes at once. Their individual strength is lower than a single focused summon, but they can split tasks, guard angles, or coordinate movement.

entries.name: Twin Strike
entries.summary: Strike with both weapons in rapid succession, using the second weapon to catch guards reset for the first.

entries.name: Twin-Horizon Judgment
entries.summary: You release a focused convergence of dusk-born radiance and shadow against one powerful target or magical extreme. It is especially effective when the defense depends on absolute light or absolute darkness.
